name: Ice Monarch
description: (Tag:ice)(Tag:ice+)You are the Ice Monarch, ruler of all ice; you massively resist all elemental effects, and every element contacting you freezes. All your ice and frost-related abilities below Mythical Tier are increased by rank and cost less energy. All ice and frost-aligned beings instinctively recognize you as Monarch, and you are immune to ice and cold-based abilities.
